name: OPERATION: IRON FRONT
description: Single-player open-world military game on the 12 km island of Varden, against AI. Campaign: 12 missions in two chapters (ambush, boat and helicopter assaults, night raids, armour, jets). Free Roam with your squad, any vehicle and sandbox tools. Battle: TDM, Domination, Conquest, King of the Hill, CTF, Sector Control, Survival. AI crews drive and gun vehicles.

credits.work: All models, code and sound effects
